newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end mixed, trade lacklustre.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end mixed, trade lacklustre.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended mixed in lacklustre trade on Wednesday as the market was pressured by weaker prices in producing countries, traders said.
Prices ranged from 1.2 yen per kg lower to 0.6 yen up. Benchmark January was down 1.0 yen at 119.1 yen.

"Market attention is centred on highly volatile platinum group metals. In the rubber market, sentiment was dampened by a view that last week's gains were fundamentally unjustified, and on weaker overseas prices," one commodity analyst said. "Rubber futures are likely to drift sideways for some time, looking for clear direction," he said.
